crossRefs.note: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are…

So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
translations.bsb: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.
translations.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather
translations.asv: And if they blow but one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
